hypothesis: With four agents that each own one action, an adaptive graph (links opened on demand, dropped after use) reaches more successes than a fixed path graph with delta-sync gossip under the same per-task byte cap.
null_hypothesis: Adaptive-graph success does not exceed fixed-graph success by the threshold at the byte cap.
guardrails: success per KB of adaptive >= fixed
stop_rules: any digest, schema, split, or budget mismatch
